name: nginx + PHP-FPM
author: noahfaiq@gmail.com
description: nginx (stable branch) with PHP-FPM on Alpine, running unprivileged. Upload your site to the web root folder (default /public); site config is in nginx/conf.d, PHP overrides in php/conf.d. Type 'reload' in the console after editing configs. Includes composer and the extensions most CMSes and frameworks need (gd, intl, mysqli, pdo_mysql, pdo_pgsql, zip, bcmath, exif, redis, opcache).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash # nginx + PHP-FPM installation script # # Server files: /mnt/server # Safe to re-run: existing site files and configs are never overwritten. set -eu case "${WEBROOT}" in ""|/*|*..*) echo "Invalid WEBROOT '${WEBROOT}'"; exit 1 ;; esac mkdir -p /mnt/server cd /mnt/server mkdir -p nginx/conf.d php/conf.d "${WEBROOT}" # Latest template is always available for reference cat > nginx/default.conf.example <<'EOF' # Default site - edit freely, a reinstall never overwrites this file. # Port, web root, upload limit, timeout and access log come from the panel # variables via /tmp/nginx/panel.conf (regenerated on every start). # After editing, type "reload" in the console. server { include /tmp/nginx/panel.conf; server_name _; index index.php index.html; add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always; add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always; add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always; # Behind Cloudflare or another reverse proxy? Uncomment and list the proxy # IP ranges so logs and PHP see the real visitor IP. # set_real_ip_from 10.0.0.0/8; # real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For; include /etc/nginx/snippets/security.conf; location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$query_string; } include /etc/nginx/snippets/php.conf; } EOF if [ ! -f nginx/conf.d/default.conf ]; then cp nginx/default.conf.example nginx/conf.d/default.conf echo "Created nginx/conf.d/default.conf" fi if [ ! -f php/conf.d/99-custom.ini ]; then cat > php/conf.d/99-custom.ini <<'EOF' ; Your PHP overrides - loaded after the image defaults, so they win. ; Note: values set here override the panel variables (memory limit, upload size, ...). ; Restart the server or type "reload" in the console to apply. ; ; max_input_vars = 3000 ; display_errors = On ; development only EOF echo "Created php/conf.d/99-custom.ini" fi if [ -z "$(ls -A "${WEBROOT}")" ]; then cat > "${WEBROOT}/index.php" <<'EOF' It works

EOF echo "Created placeholder ${WEBROOT}/index.php" fi echo "-----------------------------------------" echo "Installation completed - upload your site to /${WEBROOT}" echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Web Root Folder
variables.description: Folder inside the server that is served to visitors, e.g. 'public' or 'public_html'. Laravel: upload the project to the server root and keep 'public'.

variables.name: PHP Memory Limit
variables.description: Maximum memory per PHP request, e.g. 128M, 256M, 1G.

variables.name: Max Upload Size
variables.description: Largest request body / file upload accepted by nginx and PHP, e.g. 64M or 1G.

variables.name: Max Execution Time
variables.description: Seconds a PHP request may run before it is stopped.

variables.name: PHP Workers
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent PHP processes. 'auto' sizes it from the server's memory (~64 MB each).

variables.name: Disabled PHP Functions
variables.description: Comma-separated PHP functions blocked for web requests (not for composer). Clear it if your app needs to run shell commands.

variables.name: Access Log
variables.description: 1 = show every request in the console, 0 = errors only.

variables.name: Composer Auto Install
variables.description: 1 = run 'composer install --no-dev' on every start when composer.json exists in the server root.
